title: The fake L9 incident document
summary: Jesse Michels tells of The fake L9 incident document, about 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: there was actually a fake >> document created called the L9 incident at Ellsworth Air Force Base, which was a day before Michael and Mario's experience

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a document about something called the L9 incident at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, dated a day before an experience he says two men, Michael and Mario, had there in 1977. According to Michels, the document was a fake, and he links it to Richard Doty, a former Air Force intelligence agent. He tells it because a forged paper made to land beside a real event would suggest someone was working to muddy that event.
